name: workflow_goto
description: Move the run cursor to a named step id. Use this to loop back to an earlier step (e.g. replan after an unsatisfactory result), retry a phase, or skip ahead when a decision branch warrants it. The target stepId must exist in the workflow tree. A reason is REQUIRED — the orchestrator must articulate why it is jumping rather than completing the current step. This produces an auditable record of the agent's control-flow decisions. Does not execute the target step; follow with workflow_run_step.

stepId.description: Target step id. Must resolve to an id present in the workflow tree.

reason.description: Why the orchestrator is jumping to this step instead of advancing normally. Recorded in run history.
